Bitkilerinin artık bir yeri var.
Bitkiye bir yer ver: ev, yazlık, ailenin evi. Raf ona göre gruplar, ona göre filtreler, basılı tutunca bitki taşınır.
Nerede durduğunu söyle: ev içi, balkon, teras, bahçe, ya da toprağa dikili. Sulama gününü değiştiriyor, ne kadar değiştirdiğini de yazıyor.
Sulama nihayet mevsimi biliyor. Ocaktaki bir bitki temmuz hızıyla su içmez.
Her bitki sayfasında "Neden N günde bir?" var: katalog, ışık, durduğu yer, mevsim, hepsi tek tek.
BAŞKALARININ BİTKİLERİ
Topluluk geldi. Kendi bitkini göster, başkasınınkine nazar bırak, kahverengi uçlar ne demek diye sor.
Yalnız bitki. Her fotoğraf yayınlanmadan önce kontrol ediliyor.
Hesap yalnız topluluk için. Bitkilerin telefonunda kalıyor.

v1.6 — The Ultimate Padel & Tennis Update: Doubles, H2H & Deep Link Sharing!
We’ve been working hard based on your amazing feedback. Here is what’s new in v1.6:

Match Import via Link: You can now share a match result with your opponent via a simple link. When they tap it, the match opens directly in their app, and the score/result automatically flips to their perspective!
Full Doubles Mode: You can now input 4 player names for Padel and Doubles Tennis. The app handles the automatic serve rotation and the Watch will announce exactly whose turn it is to serve.
iPhone Match Setup: Don't want to fiddle with your watch before a match? Configure everything (game type, players, deuce rules) on your iPhone and tap "Send to Watch" to sync instantly.
Head-to-Head Tracking: Save your regular opponents and filter your logbook to see your lifetime win/loss record against them.
Logbook Tags: Match formats (Bo3, 1 Set, Training) are now displayed as clean badges right in your match history.
UI Polish: Cleaner share cards for Practice sessions and overall layout improvements.
Enjoy your matches, and keep the feedback coming!
Practice Mode: A new dedicated mode for training sessions — just start and let the watch track your workout stats without keeping score
Stability improvements and performance optimizations
Hotfix & Improvements:
Fixed: Solved a bug where tie-break scores were displayed as 6-6 instead of 7-6.
Fixed: Resolved an issue with adding photos to match results.
Fixed: Serve indicators now stay visible during "Game Point" alerts on Apple Watch.
New: Academy Tab! Added a complete guide for Rules, Tactics, and App Features.
Improved: Share Activity cards now support better layouts for match details.
Thank you for your feedback! Keep them coming.

NEW: Share Your Victory
Turn your match results into professional scorecards instantly!
3 Stunning Styles: Choose between "Modern" (Photo/Gradient), "Classic Court" (Real textures), or "Sticker" (Transparent overlay).

watchOS 10 Support: We heard you! The app requirement has been lowered to watchOS 10.0. It now works on Apple Watch Series 4, 5, SE, and newer models.
Super Tie-Break Logic: Fixed a bug where the 3rd set wouldn't correctly switch to a 10-point tie-break if the 2nd set ended in a standard tie-break.
Summary Screen: Fixed an issue where the final score appeared as "0-0" games instead of points in Super Tie-Break mode.
UI Polish: Added clearer labels for "Unlimited Mode" and "Super Tie-Break" in the setup screen.
HUGE UPDATE v1.3: Super Tie-Break, Star Point & Health Stats!
We listened to your feedback on Reddit, and we delivered. This update makes the app truly "Pro" level.
Super Tie-Break Mode: Added by popular request! In Setup, toggle the sets to see "Bo3 (S.TB)". This plays a standard Best of 3 match, but the final set becomes a 10-point Tie-Break.
"Bronze Point" (Hybrid 2): We expanded the Deuce rules. You can now choose "Hyb (2)" to play 2 full Advantages before switching to Sudden Death (Golden Point).
Health Stats Dashboard: Swipe LEFT on the score screen to see your live Heart Rate, Active Calories, and Distance.
Visual Service Aid: Forget "Deuce" or "Ad" court confusion. We added clear "LEFT / RIGHT" visual indicators with arrows at the top of the screen.
Compact UI Fix: Complete layout redesign for 40mm/41mm Apple Watch users. No more squished text!
Fixes: Solved the "Defeat" bug in Unlimited Mode and improved the "End Match" flow.
We’ve been working hard to make this the best umpire on your wrist. Here is what’s new:
Unlimited Games Mode: New in Setup! Toggle past 5 sets to unlock the "Unlimited" mode. Perfect for timed tournaments or casual play without set limits.
"Hybrid" (Silver) Point Rule: Added the popular "1 Advantage, then Golden Point" rule. Especially designed for Padel players.
Coin Toss: Can't decide who serves first? Use the new randomizer tool on the setup screen.
Cloud Sync: Your match history is now safer. We rebuilt the database to support seamless cloud syncing and future leaderboard features.
New Match Summary: Enjoy a confetti celebration and see "Total Points Won" stats directly on your wrist.
Improved Logbook: Better "Save" experience and keyboard layouts for easier note-taking on your iPhone.
Stability: Fixed database migration issues and improved performance.
The biggest update yet! We’ve turned your Apple Watch into a true pro umpire.
Workout Integration: Matches are now saved as "Tennis" or "Padel" workouts in Apple Health! This keeps your watch screen active during the match and tracks your heart rate & calories.
Voice Umpire: Enable "Voice Score" in Setup to hear score announcements like a real TV broadcast.
Smart Sync: Scores now sync instantly to your phone, even if it's locked in your bag.
Match Duration: Track exactly how long your match lasted.
